feed.title: Sticky OS blog
feed.subtitle: Releases and notes from Sticky OS, open-source firmware for the Seeed reTerminal Sticky e-paper board.

entry.title: Sticky OS 1.9: a daily Sudoku for the fridge door
entry.summary: A new daily puzzle, Sudoku, under Daily next to Daily maths: made on the board from the date with no internet, the same on every board running the same version, at three levels, with pencil marks, a streak and best times.

entry.title: Sticky OS 1.8: Solitaire, Mines, Four in a Row and Chess
entry.summary: Four new games on the e-paper board: Klondike Solitaire, Mines in three sizes, Four in a Row and Chess against the board at three levels.

entry.title: AI recipes by voice: ask the fridge door what’s for dinner
entry.summary: Say a dish to the reTerminal Sticky, or type it, and the AI writes the recipe: ingredients to tick, numbered steps and tips, saved on the board. A real run, timed.

entry.title: Sticky OS 1.6: Tutor speaks English
entry.summary: 7th grade geometry lessons in English and Romanian: the same exercises in both, with hints that never give the answer away.

entry.title: How to install custom firmware on the reTerminal Sticky
entry.summary: Flashing Sticky OS on the reTerminal Sticky: a backup, esptool or ESP Tool at 115200 baud, the first start, common errors and going back.

entry.title: Your Google Calendar on an e-paper fridge display, no subscription
entry.summary: Google, iCloud or Outlook on the reTerminal Sticky through a secret iCal link: up to three calendars, every 30 minutes, no account and no subscription.

entry.title: reTerminal Sticky e-reader: EPUB, MOBI and PDF from a microSD card
entry.summary: EPUB, MOBI, AZW3, FB2 and PDF from a microSD card: putting books on the card, the library, text sizes, bookmarks and statistics.

entry.summary: Seeedash, Sticky OS, TRMNL, CrossPoint Reader, ESPHome and OpenDisplay side by side, and which to pick.

entry.title: Restore the Seeedash firmware on the reTerminal Sticky

entry.summary: EPUB, MOBI, AZW3, FB2, PDF and text from a microSD card, in justified serif pages, with contents, bookmarks and reading statistics.
